title: NEXUS Event
description: Every event that flows through NEXUS. The atomic unit of the SISO bus and the JAA event_log. Immutable after construction (§K1). Carries causedBy for full causal chain reconstruction (§A3).

type.description: Dot-namespaced event type (e.g. guardian.heartbeat, spec.checked, gap.resolved)

source.description: Module ID that emitted this event

causedBy.description: UUID of the event or JAA row that caused this event (§A3)

_rowId.description: Monotone row ID assigned by JAA on insert — the logical ordering axis (§3.2)

ts.description: Wall timestamp (Unix ms) — display metadata only, never used for ordering (§3.2)
